description: This file contains test cases for the GatewayEnvironment component, focusing on version parsing, normalization, compatibility checks, port configuration, and expected version extraction.

methods.name: `semver parses common forms`
methods.description: Test method verifying parsing of various semantic version strings, including normal, prefixed, with suffixes, and invalid cases.

methods.name: `gateway version output strips product prefix before parsing`
methods.description: Test method checking that the gateway version output is normalized by removing product prefix before parsing as Semver.

methods.name: `semver compatibility requires same major and not older`
methods.description: Test method validating semantic version compatibility rules regarding major, minor, and patch versions.

methods.name: `gateway port defaults and respects override`
methods.description: Asynchronous test verifying default gateway port and override via user defaults.

methods.name: `expected gateway version from string uses parser`
methods.description: Test method confirming that expected gateway version strings are properly parsed into Semver objects.
